detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic ultra-realistic contemporary African mining drama, documentary-grade natural light mixed with hard sources, true skin texture with sweat and fine dust, real cloth physics on worn cotton, red laterite dust in the air, high dynamic range style. [Shot 1] the shot follows the viewpoint and subject placement of <Picture 1>; the subject is the same two people throughout, the woman in a grey-blue apron and the young man seen from behind in a pale-blue shirt. The camera holds a static shot. Her hands rub once against the front of her apron and settle folded again; her upper body stays tipped forward and her head turns a few degrees toward her son and back; the young man in the near foreground stays completely still. The speaker (S1) says, light and deferential, the last three words lifting as if asking permission, <d>[Chinese] 刘姐，瑶瑶，小砚到了。</d> an air-conditioning hum only.
